high_frequency_traces.description: Optimize high-frequency traces to minimize length and crossings
high_frequency_traces.implementation: Use shortest path possible, minimize vias, maintain consistent impedance

critical_path_lengths.description: Maintain critical path lengths to ensure proper timing
critical_path_lengths.implementation: Use length matching for critical signals, minimize skew

signal_crossings.description: Minimize signal crossings to reduce interference
signal_crossings.implementation: Use vias to cross between layers, avoid crossing high-frequency signals

power_delivery_paths.description: Verify power delivery paths to ensure proper power distribution
power_delivery_paths.implementation: Use appropriate trace width, minimize length, use copper pours

ground_plane_integrity.description: Maintain ground plane integrity to ensure proper grounding
ground_plane_integrity.implementation: Minimize ground plane cuts, use stitching vias
